faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Everything that's usually still open before a project. If something's missing, just ask directly.

items.question: What does a professional website cost?
items.answer: Compact websites start at around €1,500; more extensive projects with a CMS, shop, or custom features cost more. Price is determined by page count, design, features, integrations and content. After the initial consultation you'll receive a transparent quote.

items.question: How long does building a website take?
items.answer: Depending on scope, 1 to 8 weeks. A compact website is live in one to two weeks; larger projects with a CMS, multiple languages, or a shop take longer. The biggest time factor is usually how quickly the content is ready.

items.question: Can I edit content myself later?
items.answer: Yes, if you'd like. On request you get a CMS where you can maintain text, images, posts and entire pages yourself. We agree beforehand on what's editable. Without a CMS, I handle changes on request.

items.question: Is SEO included with the website?
items.answer: The technical foundation is always included: clean site structure, fast load times, meta data, sitemap and mobile optimization. Ongoing SEO with keyword research, content and monitoring is a continuous effort and can be booked separately.

items.question: Do you also do the web design?
items.answer: Yes. The design is created in Figma, you see it before development and give feedback. Development only starts after your approval.

items.question: Can you implement an existing design?
items.answer: Yes, design-to-code is its own service. You provide your Figma design or another template, and I implement it pixel-perfect, performant and responsive.

items.question: Do you rework existing websites?
items.answer: Yes. From a redesign on the existing base to a full rebuild. During a migration I handle content, URL structure and redirects so existing rankings are preserved.

items.question: What technologies do you use?
items.answer: Typically Next.js and React with TypeScript, hosted on modern platforms like Vercel. A headless CMS is added for editorial content. The choice follows the project, not the other way around.

items.question: Is the website mobile optimized?
items.answer: Yes. Every website is built responsively and tested on smartphone, tablet and desktop. Mobile display and load time are part of the acceptance check.

items.question: Do you provide support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. Maintenance, updates, monitoring and further development can be booked on an ongoing or as-needed basis. You're not left alone after launch.
